```{python}
#| label: fig-bench-sec-authorize
#| fig-cap: "Authorization decision cost and scope-depth scaling"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(7, 3.0))

# Decision costs
decisions = ['Allow\n(prefix d2)', 'Deny\n(scope miss)', 'Deny\n(revoked)']
costs = [36.8, 3.1, 40.5]
ax = axes[0]
ax.bar(decisions, costs, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.0)
ax.bar(decisions[1], costs[1], color='#dddddd', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.0)
for d, c in zip(decisions, costs):
    ax.text(d, c + 1.5, f'{c:.1f}', ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel('Cost per decision (ns)', fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('Decision cost', fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0, 52)
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)
ax.annotate('fail-closed\n~12x cheaper', xy=(1, 3.1), xytext=(1.28, 24), fontsize=7,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=0.8))

# Scope-depth scaling
depths = [1, 2, 3, 19]
depth_costs = [36.0, 38.7, 38.4, 62.7]
ax = axes[1]
ax.plot(depths, depth_costs, 'o-', color='black', markerfacecolor='white',
        markeredgecolor='black', markersize=6, linewidth=1.4)
for d, c in zip(depths, depth_costs):
    ax.text(d, c + 2, f'{c:.0f}', ha='center', fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel('Scope depth (coords)', fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('Cost per decision (ns)', fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('Scope-depth scaling', fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(depths)
ax.set_ylim(30, 80)
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)
ax.annotate('O(scope depth),\nnot store size', xy=(19, 62.7), xytext=(9.5, 72), fontsize=7,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=0.8))

fig.tight_layout()
```
